mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate indicates an accommodative monetary policy, which tends to boost equity markets by reducing borrowing costs and increasing liquidity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not higher than baseline during periods of low FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in unemployment rate above 9% signals labor market weakness, which may lead to economic downturns and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in >60% of cases when UNRATE exceeds 9%.

mechanism_narrative: When both payroll employment and housing starts increase, it indicates strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: Correlation between the two proxies and SPX returns is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production suggests increased economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO increases by 1% in a month
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative when INDPRO increases by 1% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Growth in real state and local government finance indicates increased government spending, which may boost equity markets, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: RSAFS growth does not correlate with positive SPX returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A high consumer price index suggests inflationary pressures, which may lead to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive when CPIAUCSL exceeds 220 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When federal funds rate is low and unemployment rate is high, it indicates a supportive monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: No significant positive correlation between the joint behavior of proxies and SPX returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth indicates a strong economy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth > 1% in the last quarter
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth does not lead to positive SPX returns (t-test p > 0.05).
